{{Top|fa}} {{Youmay|the [[canon]] individual|the [[Galek (tree)|Galek]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity|linebreak=1}} {{Character |type=First Order |image=[[File:Galek-Breakout.png]] |name=Galek |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[34 ABY]], over [[Dantooine]]{{ResistanceDate|2|17}} Therefore, Galek's [[death]] over [[Dantooine]], as depicted in "Rebuilding the Resistance," occurred in 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]]. |species=[[Human]]{{Databank|lieutenant-galek|Lieutenant Galek}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]] |pronouns=She/her |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]], graying{{Resistance|Live Fire}} |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[First Order]] **[[First Order Navy]]{{Resistance|Rebuilding the Resistance}} **[[First Order Academy]] **[[First Order Special Forces]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' — Based on corresponding data for [[First Order Special Forces]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Our Order is built on survival of the fittest. If one pilot can't do their duty and they die serving the First Order, so be it. The Order becomes stronger by culling the weak.|Galek|audio=CullingTheWeak-LiveFire.flac|}} '''Galek''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served the [[First Order]] as a [[lieutenant]], [[flight instructor]], and [[First Order Special Forces|Special Forces]] member by [[34 ABY]]. During her service aboard the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'', the lieutenant utilized a live-fire exercise to train a batch of [[cadet]]s, including the recruits [[Tamara Ryvora|DT-533]], [[Jace Rucklin|DT-798]], and [[Lin Gaava]]. DT-533 saved DT-798 during the exercise, embarrassing Galek in front of [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] and earning her ire. She believed in the survival of the fittest and made this belief known to DT-533 and DT-798. The lieutenant later tasked the pair with traveling to the ''[[Titan]]'' [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|refueling station]] on a supply run, citing their familiarity with the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station's]] layout. Later in 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]], Galek led the [[Hunt for the Colossus|search]] for the [[Realspace|space]] station ''[[Colossus]]'' at the [[planet]] [[Varkana]]. Although she located the ''Colossus'', the station eventually eluded her grasp by fleeing into [[hyperspace]]. Galek confronted the [[Space station|station]] again at the planet [[Aeos Prime]], where she commanded her [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|squadron]] as it flew into [[Battle of Aeos Prime|battle]]. During the confrontation, the [[Resistance]] agent [[Kazuda Xiono]] launched a [[missile]] at the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], but the attack was thwarted by DT-533, who saved Galek's life. DT-533's actions earned her a promotion to [[Second Squadron Commander]], for which Galek was present. After receiving intelligence that the Resistance was attempting to escort recruits through a [[Blockade of Dantooine|blockade]] on the planet [[Dantooine]], Galek ordered her [[squadron]] into action and joined the battle in a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE/fo fighter]]. The lieutenant [[Death|died]] in the resulting skirmish when [[Jade Leader]] [[Venisa Doza]] destroyed her [[TIE series|TIE fighter]]. Her death led to DT-533 being promoted to [[Squad leader|squadron leader]]. ==Biography== ===Training the volunteers=== {{Quote|Your job was to destroy the enemy, not to rescue lesser pilots who shouldn't have survived on their own merit. You embarrassed me in front of Commander Pyre.|Galek berating DT-533|audio=LesserPilots-LiveFire.flac|}} [[File:Galek-HotshotsAndAcesII.png|thumb|left|250px|alt=A squadron of seven TIE fighters fly through an asteroid field.|Galek flew a TIE/fo fighter.]] [[Lieutenant]] Galek was a [[human]] [[flight instructor]] of the [[First Order]]. At some point, the lieutenant [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|piloted]] a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]] through an [[asteroid field]], accompanied by multiple other [[TIE series|TIE fighters]].{{FFGXW2|set=Hotshots and Aces II Reinforcements Pack|cardname=Lieutenant Galek}} In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|3}} Galek was stationed aboard the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]''.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' She surveyed her [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|squadron]] in a [[hangar]] as three [[cadet]]s arrived late—[[Tamara Ryvora|DT-533]], [[Jace Rucklin|DT-798]], and [[Lin Gaava]]—with their [[First Order TIE fighter pilot helmet|helmets]] off. The [[instructor]] admonished the group for their incomplete [[First Order TIE pilot flight suit|uniforms]], reminding them they had not earned that privilege. After DT-533 apologized, Galek informed the gathered cadets that her job was to [[First Order Academy|train]] the [[squadron]] to improve their skills as [[pilot]]s, whereas their job was to follow her commands. The lieutenant ordered the cadets to board their [[starfighter]]s to begin their first exercise, but DT-533 remained behind, wishing to speak to Galek. The [[First Order officer|officer]] did not hear DT-533 out, instead re-iterating the order for the cadet to board her [[Starship|ship]]. The exercise set the six recruits against three [[Microraptor-class target drone|X-wing drones]]. From the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the ''Thunderer'', Galek informed the pilots that they would be using live fire during the training—stressing that [[stun]] blasts were non-existent in a real battle—and that whoever scored the most points through destroying [[drone]]s would become [[squad leader]]. She then signaled the start of the exercise before viewing the cadets' actions from a [[Computer|console]]. DT-533 destroyed the first drone, which Galek announced to the squadron before urging the others to try harder to impress her. [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] took notice of the promising results of the exercise, with Galek signaling DT-533 as a good example—much to Pyre's satisfaction. When DT-798 lost control of his{{Resistance|Station to Station}} fighter from friendly fire, his TIE began hurtling toward the [[Star Destroyer]]. DT-533 broke off her attack and helped guide DT-798 away from danger, as Galek and Pyre observed through the [[viewport]]s. Pyre referred to DT-533 as a "hero" before departing, embarrassing Galek. [[File:GalenRyvoraAndRucklin-LiveFire.png|thumb|right|250px|Galek looks upon the recruits DT-533 and DT-798.]] Galek angrily{{SW|url=live-fire-episode-gallery|text="Live Fire" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}} recalled the trainees and ended the exercise. The instructor met with DT-533 and DT-798, as the latter admitted he probably would not have saved DT-533. Galek informed DT-533 that he was correct, and because of her actions, she was stripped of her squadron leader [[Military rank|rank]]. When the cadet protested, citing her points scored and skill demonstrated in saving DT-798, Galek criticized her for breaking off the attack and risking the mission. Galek educated the cadet on her mission—to [[Death|destroy]] the enemy—and that she should not be rescuing "lesser" pilots who could not survive on their own. She also revealed that the cadet had embarrassed her in front of Pyre. Galek silenced DT-798's attempt to speak, telling the two cadets that the First Order was strengthened through the survival of the fittest and that losing weaker pilots was natural. After reminding DT-533 that it was her job to follow orders and receiving the cadet's confirmation of understanding, she departed with DT-798. ===General First Order duties=== {{Quote|Commander Pyre has an important meeting at one of our key refueling stations, the ''Titan''. I want you to take a shuttle for a supply run.''"
"''Oh, a supply run. Yes, sir.''"
"''Remove that smirk, 798. You're going as well, since you both are familiar with these kinds of stations.|Galek and DT-533|audio=SupplyRun-StationToStation.flac|}} [[File:GalekBriefsRyvora-StationToStation.png|thumb|left|250px|Galek briefs DT-533 on her mission to the ''Titan''.]] Later that [[Standard year|year]], Galek approached DT-533 and DT-798 in the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} hangar, Galek briefing the pilot on her new mission—taking a [[shuttle]] on a supply run to the ''[[Titan]]'', a key First Order [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|refueling station]]. DT-533's excitement for a new assignment dissipated at the nature of the mission, causing her companion to smirk. The lieutenant scolded DT-798 and assigned him on the endeavor as well, citing the two cadets' familiarity with [[Supertanker fuel depot|stations]] of the ''Titan''{{'s}} variety—both pilots having previously been residents aboard the ''[[Colossus]]'', the same type of [[Fuel|refueling]] [[Space station|station]] as the ''Titan'', on the [[planet]] [[Castilon]] before enlisting with the [[First Order Navy]]. Galek ordered the cadets to immediately depart, after which she dismissed them and left their presence. As the two pilots proceeded to the ''Titan'', DT-798 pondered what Galek had meant about their familiarity with the stations, though his companion was unsure. Later in 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]], after [[bounty hunter]] [[Ax Tagrin]] informed Pyre he had [[Rescue of Norath Kev|captured]] [[Kazuda Xiono]]{{Resistance|The Missing Agent}}—a [[Resistance]] member affiliated with the ''Colossus'' and [[Bounty|wanted]] by the First Order{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}}—and other Resistance members on the planet [[Varkana]], the ''Thunderer'' traveled to the planet with Galek aboard. Galek remained on the Star Destroyer and [[Hunt for the Colossus|searched]] for the ''Colossus''. At the same [[time]], Pyre and [[First Order Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] went to the planet's surface to retrieve the captured Resistance members, although Xiono had escaped. Once [[CB-23]], [[Synara San]], and [[Jarek Yeager]] were in First Order [[Prisoner|captivity]], Pyre contacted Galek via [[hologram]]. The lieutenant informed the commander of the lack of results in the search for the ''Colossus'', after which the latter ordered the former to continue the efforts and urged her to be thorough.{{Resistance|Breakout}} [[File:PyreBriefsGalek-Breakout.png|thumb|right|250px|Pyre informs Galek of the ''Colossus''{{'s}} location.]] Tagrin tracked down the Resistance agents' [[Unidentified Star Commuter 2000|shuttle]] and tricked the ''Colossus''{{'s}} crew into revealing their location in [[orbit]] around Varkana. The bounty hunter passed the location on to Pyre, who then contacted Galek via hologram again and transferred the coordinates, commanding Galek to find and destroy the ''Colossus''. Galek responded affirmatively before ordering a nearby First Order [[officer]] to follow the coordinates, confident in the upcoming capture of the station. As the ''Thunderer'' converged on the ''Colossus''{{'s}} position inside a [[Color|red]]-colored [[nebula]], the lieutenant commanded the starship's crew to engage the [[tractor beam]]s and prepare all [[cannon]]s. The ''Colossus'', however, jumped into [[hyperspace]] before Galek could give the command for the ''Thunderer'' to engage it. She then contacted Pyre and debriefed him on the ''Colossus''{{'s}} escape. Later, as the Resistance members escaped Varkana aboard their [[Star Commuter 2000]] shuttle, Pyre ordered Galek to scramble her TIE fighters in order to stop them, though those efforts were ultimately in vain as well due to the ''Colossus'' returning and extracting the agents. ===The hunt continues=== {{Quote|The ''Colossus'' is not to be allowed to escape. Disable it by any means necessary.|Galek|audio=AnyMeans-NoPlaceSafe.flac|{{Resistance|No Place Safe}}}} The First Order later sent [[Spider probe droid|probe droids]] to search for the ''Colossus'' while DT-533 was looking out at [[Realspace|space]] from a hangar aboard the ''Thunderer'' without her [[Flight helmet|helmet]] on; DT-798 then startled her by mimicking Galek and inquiring as to why her [[helmet]] was off. Meanwhile, on the bridge of the ''Thunderer'', Galek reviewed a terminal's output with Pyre and Tierny, but was interrupted by a nearby [[Unidentified First Order lieutenant (Thunderer)|officer]], who informed Pyre of an incoming transmission from one of the [[Probe droid|probes]] originating near the planet [[Aeos Prime]]. Galek remained at the terminal as Pyre and Tierny left to review the transmission. Upon recognizing Xiono in it, Pyre ordered the Star Destroyer to the [[Aeos system]] and for pilots to rush to their fighters. [[File:ScaredGalek-NoPlaceSafe.png|thumb|left|250px|Galek reacts to Kazuda Xiono firing a missile at the bridge of the ''Thunderer''.]] As the ''Thunderer'' approached Aeos Prime, a squadron of TIE fighters and [[TIE/se Bomber|bombers]] exited the Star Destroyer and flew toward the planet's surface. Galek contacted the squadron over [[Comm unit|comms]] and instructed the pilots to impair the ''Colossus'' to prevent its escape, with DT-798 acknowledging the orders. During the ensuing [[Battle of Aeos Prime|battle]], the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[Ace Squadron]] attacked the ''Thunderer'' head-on to provide the ''Colossus'' with an opportunity to escape. As the Ace Squadron closed in, Galek was actively using a terminal aboard the bridge of the Star Destroyer, and the lieutenant was shocked when [[Jarek Yeager's racer]], piloted by Xiono, fired a [[missile]] at the bridge. However, DT-533 destroyed the missile, saving Galek, Pyre, and Tierny. Pyre was impressed with the pilot and made Galek tell him their designation. After the battle, Galek accompanied Tierny to DT-533's [[Barracks|quarters]] and called the cadet to attention, after which Tierny informed the pilot that she had been promoted to [[Second Squadron Commander]]. ===A lesser pilot=== {{Quote|I know you're upset. Understand that Lieutenant Galek died in service to the First Order and was a fine squadron commander, but her failure has now created opportunities for others. There is one less group of Resistance we have to worry about, thanks to you. DT-533, you are now promoted to squadron leader.|Tierny, to DT-533 on Galek's death|audio=TamPromoted-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} [[File:GalekYellsAtRyvora-RebuildingTheResistance.png|thumb|right|250px|Galek chastises DT-533 for speaking out.]] Galek met with DT-533, Pyre, and Tierny on the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} bridge as an [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] displayed a hologram of the planet [[Dantooine]]. Tierny shared a report of [[Resistance shuttle|shuttles]] with Resistance recruits aboard trying to escape off-world, and Pyre noted the patrolling First Order [[Unidentified First Order TIE squadron|squadron]] that was enforcing a [[Blockade of Dantooine|blockade]] on the planet had ceased communications. The commander then ordered Galek to set course for the planet and to activate her squadron, wishing for the Resistance [[convoy]] to be found and eliminated. When DT-533 protested due to the shuttles being [[Weapon|unarmed]], Galek questioned if that posed a problem for her. After the Second Squadron Commander relented, the lieutenant further suggested that she stay silent and then donned her own helmet as the Star Destroyer entered hyperspace. Later, while the ''Thunderer'' was still en route to Dantooine, Galek ordered all squadrons to prepare for launch over the Star Destroyer's intercom. [[File:GalekGoesDown-RebuildingTheResistance.png|thumb|left|250px|Galek's TIE fighter is hit and begins to spiral.]] At Dantooine, Galek flew a TIE/fo fighter alongside a First Order squadron. As the squadron engaged with the Resistance convoy, she confirmed the First Order's targets and ordered the shuttles to be destroyed. When DT-533 suggested retreating after they had lost half of the squadron, Galek quickly dismissed the idea and insisted that they complete the mission. Galek began to pursue Xiono's fighter, the ''[[Fireball]]'', prompting the Resistance pilot to compliment her skills to CB-23. She scored a hit on the ''Fireball''{{'s}} wing and placed the ship in her [[targeting computer]]'s sights. Before she could destroy the ''Fireball'', however, Galek was surprised by her [[Alarm system|alarms]] activating due to the presence of an [[Venisa Doza's X-wing|X-wing]] piloted by [[Jade Leader]] [[Venisa Doza]] flanking her. Despite Galek's yells of protestation, Doza blasted her fighter, causing it to spiral before destroying it, with the lieutenant perishing. With Galek dead, DT-798 informed DT-533 that she was in charge. Later, after the Resistance had escaped and the First Order squadron had returned to base, Tierny met with DT-533 in the hangar. The agent comforted DT-533, believing the Second Squadron Commander to be upset over Galek, but assured her that Galek had been a good [[squadron commander]] who had died in service to the First Order and that her death would allow new opportunities for others. Tierny then promoted DT-533 to squadron leader. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|But aren't transport shuttles unarmed?''"
"''Is that a problem for you, 533?''"
"''No, sir. Not at all.''"
"''Then I suggest you keep your ears open and your mouth shut.|DT-533 and Galek|audio=Unarmed-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} [[File:GalekHelmet-RebuildingTheResistance.png|thumb|right|200px|Galek was loyal to the First Order as both a pilot and instructor.]] Galek was a human [[Gender|female]] with light skin, brown [[eye]]s, and graying brown [[hair]]. Her face had wrinkles{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-7-fun-facts-from-live-fire-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "Live Fire" - ''Star Wars Resistance''|date=2019-10-21}} by 34 ABY, and she often wore a scowl. Galek was a stern, strict, and effective flight instructor with a severe demeanor. As a lieutenant, she had little patience for cadets who failed to follow orders. She had a reputation for successfully employing harsh tactics.{{InsiderCite|198|Resistance to the End}} The lieutenant was loyal to the First Order and believed that only the strong should survive, so she always utilized live fire in training exercises and had zero tolerance for failure. She was also comfortable with destroying unarmed transports. The lieutenant believed that completing missions was a top priority and thought lower-ranking personnel should follow orders at all costs and without questioning them. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|[CB-23 beeps]
"''I see him, CB. This guy's good.''"|CB-23 and Kazuda Xiono|formatting=0|audio=ThisGuysGood-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} According to Kazuda Xiono, Galek was a skilled pilot. ==Equipment== {{Quote|There we are.|Galek, as her targeting computer locked onto Kazuda Xiono in the ''Fireball''|audio=ThereWeAre-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} Galek was equipped with a standard First Order TIE Fighter Pilot [[Flight suit|uniform]], albeit with a black military rank [[pauldron]]. Her helmet and pauldron were marked with red livery, denoting her as a [[First Order Special Forces]] member. Galek flew a TIE/fo fighter on multiple occasions and also used a TIE/se Bomber.''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'' ==Behind the scenes== [[File:ChristineDunford.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Christine Dunford provided the voice for Galek.]] Galek first appeared in "[[Live Fire]]," the third episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[October 20]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} The instructor was first pictured through concept art of her observing her squadron's first training session in the "[[Path of Resistance]]"{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One|italics=1|featurette=Path of Resistance}} featurette included in the DVD ''[[Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One]]'', which was released on [[August 20]], 2019.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-season-one-dvd|text=''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One Coming to DVD on August 20|date=2019-07-23}} She was identified as "Galek" in her premiere episode. The lieutenant was voiced by [[Christine Dunford]] and credited as "Lt. Galek." [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Jason Pichon]] drafted [[:File:Galek-ConceptArt.png|concept art]] of Galek on [[January 11]], [[2018]]. Her model was sourced from "Pilot TIE A" with modifications to the proportions. In earlier versions of the "Live Fire" script, Galek's name was "Jimes." In the [[2020]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'', Galek's TIE bomber had cosmetic options of a yellow trim or a yellow and brown recolor. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source="[[Live Fire]]" |storyboards= |concept= File:Galek-ConceptArt.png|galekA, Jason Pichon File:GalekPyre-ConceptArt-PathOfResistance.png|Concept art |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'' *{{Resistance|Live Fire}} {{1st}} {{1stID|Galek}} *{{Resistance|Station to Station}} *{{Resistance|Breakout}} *{{Resistance|No Place Safe}} *{{Resistance|Rebuilding the Resistance}} ==Sources== *{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One|italics=1|featurette=Path of Resistance}} {{1stp}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/live-fire-episode-guide|text="Live Fire" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} *{{BucketsList|uty_NdX86t8|"Live Fire"}} {{Video}} *{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-7-fun-facts-from-live-fire-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "Live Fire" -
